old_caption: The video depicts a dramatic scene where a room is engulfed in flames. The fire is already fully consuming a red couch on the left side. In the foreground, a round table covered with a white tablecloth holds a potted plant with vibrant red flowers. A second potted plant with white flowers and a remote control become visible on the table as the sequence progresses. The flames are bright orange and yellow, with smoke billowing upwards. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on capturing the progression of the fire as it engulfs more of the room.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a dramatic scene where a room is engulfed in flames. The fire starts from the background, rapidly spreading towards the foreground. The room appears to be a living space, featuring a red couch on the left side and a round table covered with a white tablecloth in the center. On the table, there are several items: a potted plant with vibrant red flowers, a smaller potted plant with white flowers, and a carton of milk. The fire intensifies, consuming these objects and creating a chaotic atmosphere. The flames are bright orange and yellow, with smoke billowing upwards. The temperature reading "300°C" is displayed at the bottom left corner of the screen, indicating the severity of the fire. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on capturing the progression of the fire as it engulfs more of the room.
caption: The video depicts an indoor room where a red upholstered sofa on the left is already fully engulfed in bright orange-yellow flames. Throughout the excerpt these flames flicker, swirl, and rise continuously, with luminous yellow tongues dominating the left-center mass. In the foreground right, a small round table draped in a light cloth holds a remote control and a potted plant with dark red flowers. The table, remote, and red-flowered plant remain stationary and unburned for the whole clip. On the right side of the sofa, fire activity intensifies as the segment progresses, with taller flame columns rising behind and beside the potted plant. A wood-paneled wall and a curtain edge form the dim background. The framing gradually widens, bringing a second potted plant with pale white flowers into view at the right edge. The burning continues unabated through the final frame, with no visible resolution.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.

or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
